  --comando-socket PATH
                    the 0600 Unix socket of the unblock command:
                    «SBLOCCA <address>» or «PING».  Without it,

  --journal         ⭐ phase 16 §12: every log line ALSO goes
                    to the systemd journal, with the fields REMOTIX_AREA,

  ⭐⭐⭐ PHASE 9 — THE FIVE CURES, AND SINCE 24 AUG 2026 ALL FIVE
     ARE ON (the user's decision, after looking at them
     on the real desktop: invariant I6 was walked through, not
     bypassed).  ⛔ Each one can still be turned off, with ONE road
     only; the value in force ends up in the log at startup,
     on AND off.  The five, and how they are turned off:
        video queue threshold     --sgombra-soglia-ms 0
        rate regulator            --niente-ritmo-adattivo
        dead line                 --niente-linea-morta
        ghost eviction            --sfratto-ms 0
        audio silence             --niente-audio-silenzio
  --sgombra-soglia-ms N
                    §5.1: a delta stuck in the queue is abandoned
                    only if the queue does not drain within N ms;
                    below the threshold it is KEPT.  ⭐ DEFAULT 100
                    (on since 24 Aug 2026).  0 = OFF, and it
                    abandons at every more recent frame,
                    as it was until 23 Aug.  ⚠ The price, `[M]`
                    09-b79: up to +160 ms of drift on a bad
                    network, ZERO on the healthy line.  The line is
                    written by webtransport.c
  --qualita-risale  quality goes back up one step after a
                    number of comfortable frames below the ceiling of
                    §6.2.  Without it, once down it stays down for
                    the whole session.  ⛔ It lives in the CHILD: the
                    line is written by codificatore.c at opening
  --tetto-banda-mbit N
                    N is the FLOOR in Mbit/s (20, §3.1-bis),
                    not the ceiling: wire, working point and
                    reservoir are derived from it.  0 = off, and
                    then nobody says no to bandwidth.  ⛔ It lives
                    in the CHILD, and applies only in hardware
  --sfratto-ms N    ⭐ the GHOST: if a user's slot is
                    held by a client silent for more than N
                    ms, and whoever asks for that slot is a client
                    of the SAME user, the slot is taken away
                    and goes to the newcomer.  ⭐ DEFAULT 15000
                    (on since 24 Aug 2026), that is half
                    the silence clock: it does not go
                    lower, because the browser's keep-alive is silent
                    `[M]` 15 s and a LIVE idle client would be
                    evicted.  ⚠ `[M]` the ghost goes from 32.13 s and
                    14 refusals to 16.83 s and 7.  0 = OFF, and the
                    slot is freed only by the silence clock
                    (30 s): whoever comes back after a drop is
                    told the slot is taken — by themselves
  --niente-ritmo-adattivo
                    ⭐⭐ TURNS OFF the rate regulator, which since 24
                    Aug 2026 is ON by default: a frame does not
                    leave when two deltas in flight still have
                    bytes in the output queue.  ⚠ The old name
                    `--ritmo-adattivo` NO LONGER exists
  --niente-linea-morta
                    ⛔⭐ TURNS OFF the DEAD LINE, which since 24 Aug 2026
                    is ON by default: a session is CLOSED
                    when the line can no longer be served — the
                    wire drops and one gets back in by hand (the
                    user's decision, 23 Aug 2026).  TWO causes: the
                    output STALL and the client's SILENCE;
                    every trigger writes in the log a
                    `linea-morta` line with the numbers it decided on (I1).
                    ⛔⛔ IT IS THE CURE THAT CLOSES A SESSION: `[M]`
                    margin >10x above the worst line that HOLDS
                    and 2.9x below the one that serves nobody.
                    ⚠ The old name `--linea-morta` NO LONGER exists

  ⭐⭐⭐ PHASE 10 — THE COMPOSITION BUDGET, and it is born OFF (I6)
  --budget-mpixel-s N
                    the Mpixel/s of COMPOSITION this machine
                    holds.  ⛔ 0 = OFF, and it is the DEFAULT:
                    without it, the server ADMITS EVERYONE and starves them
                    together (`[M]` the eleventh gets in and the first
                    session goes from 39.60 to 0.96 fps, −97.6 %%).
                    ⛔ It is NOT the ENCODER's number: `[M]` on
                    a UHD 730 the bare encoder holds 1.86
                    Gpixel/s and composition 0.97 — what saturates is
                    the compositor, not us.  Giving the former here
                    would admit ~22 sessions where six fit.
                    ⛔⛔ AND IT DOES NOT SELF-TUNE: until the machine
                    has GIVEN WAY at least once, the maximum
                    read is a lower bound, not a
                    ceiling.  Whoever types this option declares
                    they have measured.  Whoever does not fit receives CONGEDO
                    0x06 BUDGET_PIENO, before their stage is born
  --riserva F       0..1, how much of the worst case of an
                    IDLE tenant is kept aside.  ⭐ 0.5 is the
                    DEFAULT: `[M]` 0 false yes and 0 false no,
                    cap 6 saturated / 10 idle.  0 = «delivered»
                    rule (6 saturated, idle unlimited: blind
                    to WAKE-UP) · 1 = «worst» rule (5 and 6,
                    with one false no).  ⛔ It serves against wake-up:
                    `[M]` eight idle ones at 0.01 %% each wake up
                    in 19 ms and ask for 130 %% of the engine
  --tetto-sessioni N
                    the ADMINISTRATIVE cap (§4.6): how many users
                    served at most.  ⭐ DEFAULT 10
                    (SPECIFICHE.md §5.5; it was 16 until 25 Aug
                    2026, and nobody had chosen it).  From here the
                    four tables that count a user are
                    sized.  ⚠ Whoever does not fit receives 0x0E, which is
                    a different fact from 0x06: the table is full, the
                    machine is not
  --niente-audio-silenzio
                    ⭐⭐ TURNS OFF the AUDIO SILENCE, which since 24
                    Aug 2026 is ON by default: a block in which
                    ALL the samples are exactly zero does not
                    become a datagram.  ⚠ `[M]` 09-b84: 102.1
                    times less traffic with a still screen (557.6 →
                    5.5 kbit/s), 1 248 blocks silenced out of 1 248; the
                    price is +2 «missed» out of 5 000 at the client.
                    ⛔ Until 23 Aug it was a compile-time `-D`,
                    and that `-D` has been REMOVED: one road only
  --linea-morta-stallo-ms N
                    for how many ms no frame has gone out WHILE
                    HAVING some to send.  ⛔ Both halves
                    count: with a still scene there is nothing to
                    send, and the count does not even start.
                    Default 5000: 5.0 times above the whole empty

                    delivers 23.94 frames/s, and 2.9 times below

                    `raffica-forte` 123‰ and did not hold.  The
                    number stays in the log as a WITNESS
  --linea-morta-silenzio-s N
                    the seconds without a packet from the client.

                    PINGs at HALF this number, or «does not
                    answer» and «we did not ask it anything»
                    would look the same.  0 = stall
